quarterly_data.quarter: Eli Lilly press release: Lilly to acquire Merida Biosciences to advance treatments (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Lilly signed a definitive agreement to acquire Merida Biosciences, which develops biologics engineered to selectively degrade pathogenic autoantibodies. Merida's lead program, MER511, is in Phase 1 development for Graves' disease and thyroid eye disease; initial Phase 1 data show MER511 achieved robust reductions in pathogenic thyroid-stimulating antibodies with a favorable initial safety profile. Graves' disease affects approximately 3 million people in the U.S., and roughly 25 to 40 percent of them go on to develop thyroid eye disease. The pipeline also includes MER769, a preclinical program in food allergy, asthma, chronic spontaneous urticaria and other diseases driven by the antibody responsible for triggering allergic reactions, plus earlier-stage programs in kidney diseases such as membranous nephropathy. The deal is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026, subject to regulatory approvals.
quarterly_data.figure: MER511 Phase 1 (Graves' disease, thyroid eye disease); approximately 3 million U.S. Graves' patients; close expected Q4 2026
